The artifact deletes blocks 2, 6, 10, **15** and then moves block 14 into slot 11 (`model\.layers\.14\.(.*)` → `model.layers.11.\1`), but the specification's "Required result" §1 requires deleting blocks 2, 6, 10, **14**, with old block 15 (not 14) surviving and becoming new index 11 (§2: "old 15 becomes 11"). This swaps which of blocks 14/15 is dropped and which is kept, so the final `model.layers.11.*` tensors will contain old block 14's weights instead of old block 15's weights — wrong values despite passing all three required-check assertions (count of deleted range, 12-block count, 86-tensor total), since those checks don't distinguish 14 from 15. This will fail the hidden bit-exact grading in "Grading."
